import numpy as np
import datetime

def task_func(arr):
    arr_np = np.asarray(arr)

    def reverse_words(value):
        if isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
            text = value.decode()
        else:
            text = str(value)
        parts = text.split()
        return " ".join(parts[::-1]) if parts else ""

    result = np.empty(arr_np.shape, dtype=object)

    for idx in np.ndindex(arr_np.shape):
        result[idx] = reverse_words(arr_np[idx])

    return result
